Third-party files the site serves itself, each at a pinned version beside its licence. They are
copies, unchanged, of the files named here; nothing in this folder is fetched from these sources
when a page is opened.

marked-15.0.12/                 npm marked@15.0.12 (marked.min.js), MIT: LICENSE.md
highlight.js-11.9.0/            highlight.js 11.9.0 as cdnjs serves it (highlight.min.js,
                                languages/latex.min.js, styles/atom-one-dark.min.css,
                                styles/atom-one-light.min.css), BSD-3-Clause: LICENSE
chart.js-4.5.1/                 npm chart.js@4.5.1 (dist/chart.umd.min.js), MIT: LICENSE.md.
                                The charts script of the HTML the visualizer generates.
katex-0.19.0/                   npm katex@0.19.0 (dist/katex.min.js, dist/katex.min.css,
                                dist/fonts/), MIT: LICENSE. The LaTeX preview's formulas.
latex.css-1.14.0/               npm latex.css@1.14.0 (fonts/LM-*.woff2): Latin Modern Roman, by
                                GUST e-foundry, under the GUST Font License (GUST-FONT-LICENSE.txt,
                                which is the LaTeX Project Public License 1.3c, LPPL-1.3c.txt);
                                latex.css's own MIT licence: LICENSE. Original fonts:
                                https://www.gust.org.pl/projects/e-foundry/latin-modern
computer-modern-0.1.3/          npm computer-modern@0.1.3 (fonts/cmu-*.woff2, the ones the LaTeX
                                preview uses): Computer Modern Unicode, SIL Open Font License 1.1:
                                OFL.txt
pdfjs-dist-6.2.108/             npm pdfjs-dist@6.2.108 (build/pdf.worker.min.mjs, cmaps/, and of wasm/
                                the JBIG2 and OpenJPEG decoders with their JavaScript fallbacks), the
                                version the browser bundle is built with, Apache-2.0: LICENSE; the
                                decoders' own licences: wasm/LICENSE_*
tesseract.js-7.0.0/             npm tesseract.js@7.0.0 (dist/worker.min.js), the OCR worker of the
                                version the browser bundle is built with, Apache-2.0: LICENSE.md
tesseract.js-core-7.0.0/        npm tesseract.js-core@7.0.0 (tesseract-core-lstm.wasm.js,
                                tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js, tesseract-core-relaxedsimd-lstm.wasm.js:
                                the LSTM engine officeParser asks for, in the build each browser's
                                WebAssembly support picks), Apache-2.0: LICENSE

OCR's language data (@tesseract.js-data, Apache-2.0) is too large for this repository: it is served
from the owner's own storage (scripts/upload-tessdata.mjs), never from a CDN.

The site's text fonts (Inter, Outfit, JetBrains Mono) are in ../fonts, with their licences.
